title: ACP REST endpoints mapped to MCP tools
caption: The MCP binding maps each checkout endpoint to one tool and moves headers into arguments.meta. Authorization moves to MCP server configuration and ACP errors use JSON-RPC code -32000. The ChatGPT payment sheet uses a different Apps SDK tool.
alt: Two columns. REST: POST /checkout_sessions, GET /checkout_sessions/{id}, POST /checkout_sessions/{id}, POST .../complete, POST .../cancel, and headers API-Version, Idempotency-Key, Signature, Timestamp, Request-Id. MCP: create_checkout_session, get_checkout_session, update_checkout_session, complete_checkout_session, cancel_checkout_session, and arguments.meta with api_version, idempotency_key, signature, timestamp, request_id. Each REST item links to its MCP counterpart. A separate box, the Apps SDK tool complete_checkout used by the ChatGPT payment sheet, is marked as a different tool from complete_checkout_session.
